name: ValorMC | SMP
description:
Claim your land, pick a job and earn. ValorMC is a brand new Survival SMP for Java and Bedrock!

ValorMC is the survival you know, with everything that keeps a world worth logging into: protect your builds with land claims, get paid in one of 12 jobs, trade with other players and build up a base with your team. A fresh world with custom biomes is waiting to be explored.

What you'll find:

- Land claims: protect your base and trust your friends

- 12 jobs: miner, farmer, fisherman, hunter, builder, enchanter and more

- A player economy: auction house, trades, buy orders and player warps

- Crates, with free keys from voting

- Teams: build, grind and climb the leaderboards together

- Quests, daily rewards and playtime levels

- Spirits: pick a spirit with its own perks

- Stackable spawners that store and sell their own loot

- Vote rewards: streaks, a reward wheel and vote parties

- Cosmetics: chat colours, tags, trails and armour skins

- PvP is optional: switch it on or off with /togglepvp

- Our own anti-cheat and a friendly, active staff team

Join today!

Java IP: play.valormc.net

Bedrock IP: play.valormc.net (port 19132)

Discord: discord.valormc.net

Website: valormc.net
